injuries.name: Anton Harrison
injuries.note: Harrison has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Eagles in London due to a knee injury.

injuries.name: Montaric Brown
injuries.note: Brown (hamstring) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Eagles.

injuries.name: Ross Matiscik
injuries.note: Matiscik (shoulder) will not return to Sunday's game against the Eagles in London.

injuries.name: Eric Murray
injuries.note: Murray (concussion) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Eagles in London.

injuries.name: Caleb Ransaw
injuries.note: The Jaguars placed Ransaw (knee) on their injured reserve list Tuesday.

injuries.name: Jalyx Hunt
injuries.note: Hunt (ankle/knee) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Jaguars in London.

injuries.name: Michael Carter II
injuries.note: Carter (abdomen) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Jaguars in London.

injuries.name: Will Shipley
injuries.note: The Eagles ruled out Shipley (foot) for the remainder of Sunday's game versus the Jaguars in London.

injuries.name: Lane Johnson
injuries.note: The Eagles are expected to keep Johnson (personal) on the 53-man roster for the remainder of the season, even though he announced his retirement Tuesday, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Jonathan Greenard
injuries.note: Greenard (ankle) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Jaguars in London.
